verification_note: Release year is not stated on the checked official page and remains null; Fragrantica's per-fragrance entry gives 2026. Amouage marks Elsewhere as new on its Essences collection page alongside Line 618, Remain and Sequence, though that page's introductory text describes only three new expressions. editorial_context: Amouage places Elsewhere in its Essences collection and credits Pierre Négrin, stating a 30% oil concentration well above a conventional eau de parfum. The house publishes a full pyramid: top: honey, tangerine, grapefruit, mango, pomegranate, apricot, ginger, cardamom, pink pepper; heart: black tea, cappuccino, davana; base: tonka bean, vanilla, cedarwood, labdanum, cypriol, vetiver, patchouli. It also lists an Infusion Patina of sandalwood and oakwood, which it attributes to the ageing of the finished perfume rather than to the composition, so those two woods are not recorded among the notes.
